title: plastic tablecloth clips
text: plastic tablecloth clips. These clips are made for very, very thin tables... if you're planning to use on a regular thickness picnic table or the folding tables you get at the warehouse stores, they will NOT work. We tried several different ways to attach and they are just too small and brittle - just snap.  I would say they will not work on anything thicker than 3/4".  Disappointing.
